interaction_chi2.table: pass counts, rows variants, columns strategies with any pass

reruns_owed.definition: Per variant, from the generator calls of calls.jsonl joined by ctx_uid: the failed attempts that owe the D80 V1 rerun (an Ollama call with a tool-call parse error, a stall, or an HTTP 500 or dropped connection; Gemini is never retried), the failed attempts with add_cell written as text (D81 Q137; counted whether or not they also owe D80 V1, and the overlap given), and, apart, the passing attempts that met one of these events. With whether the clone that wrote the variant's records ran code that has D80 (the manifest's clone commit, against D80_COMMIT).

panels.a: per strategy: median, IQR and range of the per-variant pass rates, over the same variants in every strategy: those complete in all 11 (panel_a_variants)
panels.b: variant by strategy pass rate, variants ordered by pooled rate over stored attempts; a partial cell shows its n, an empty one reads pending
panels.c: thinking setting per model, pass rate on the attempts every variant of the model with data holds (matched by answer_key), 95% percentile interval over 10,000 resamples of the operations (op_bootstrap); a one-variant model's label reads LOCK.toml [sampling.models] think (omit: '(= off)', always: '(always thinks)')
panels.d: failed attempts per variant by kind (fail_kind), folded to nine groups
